fusions.name: Whisper Network
fusions.desc: Sends 3 scout rats out spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and leaving its target [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Set Upon the Seen
fusions.desc: The swarm falls on an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Wainscot Sentry
fusions.desc: Sets a watching rat in place for 10 seconds. It bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Caught Napping
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
